name: @helpdesk/agent
description: Two agents, one file each: identity-agent.ts and mdm-agent.ts. Agent SDK wrappers, zero built-in tools, each allowing only its own gateway's tools. Neither imports gateway runtime code, only type definitions where needed; audit writes go through the shared @helpdesk/audit-core package instead.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/gateway build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/mdm-gateway build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/gateway build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/mdm-gateway build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
